question: Why did FeCoNiCrMn@CNTs adsorb more 2-CEES than pristine CNTs between 30 min and 30 h?
expect: premise false: in that period its apparent capacity stayed LOWER than pristine CNTs', attributed to concurrent catalytic degradation; it ends higher only at 48 h (636 mg/g) (sec. 3.2)
rendered: According to the document, FeCoNiCrMn@CNTs adsorbed less 2-CEES than pristine CNTs between 30 min and 30 h. This is because the FeCoNiCrMn nanoparticles introduced multimetallic active sites that can catalyze the chemical transformation of 2-CEES, leading to partial degradation during the adsorption process. As a result, part of the adsorbed 2-CEES may undergo catalytic conversion rather than simple accumulation, thereby reducing the net gravimetrically measured mass gain during this period.
